mapper.sql: b.novel_id, n.title, n.cover_url, n.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, n.status AS novel_status, n.audit_status, b.last_read_chapter_id, c.title AS last_read_chapter_title, DATE_FORMAT(b.last_read_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS last_read_at, b.is_top, b.is_notify, DATE_FORMAT(b.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS created_at, DATE_FORMAT(b.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS updated_at, NULL AS added, NULL AS removed
FROM user_bookshelf b JOIN novel n ON n.novel_id = b.novel_id JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = n.author_id LEFT JOIN chapter c ON c.chapter_id = b.last_read_chapter_id
mapper.select: SELECT novel_id FROM novel WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} AND status IN (0, 1) AND audit_status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_bookshelf (user_id, novel_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{novelId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_bookshelf WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND novel_id = #{novelId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_bookshelf WHERE user_id = #{userId}
